digest: Safari support for AbortSignal.timeout() is directly verified as version 16 in the cited MDN BCD snapshot.
verdictDigest: The cited MDN Browser Compatibility Data entry for timeout_static lists Safari version_added as 16. Source: https://chromium.googlesource.com/external/github.com/mdn/browser-compat-data/%2B/8d6e771cb2ecd7b8b722f4beb1c8fd1e7cf3ec09/api/AbortSignal.json. Caveat: this verifies timeout(), not any().

evidence.relevance: Within timeout_static support data, this directly records Safari support beginning in version 16; safari_ios is marked mirror.

caveats: The evidence applies specifically to AbortSignal.timeout(), not AbortSignal.any().
